headline: Rathee family and Sarla Chahal file substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Kuldip Singh Rathee, Vijay Rathee, Prashant Rathee, Aman Rathee, Kanika Rathee and Sarla Chahal have jointly filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in ASK Automotive Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure obligations under SEBI's takeover regime for acquisitions crossing 5% threshold.
detail: The Rathee family members (Kuldip Singh, Vijay, Prashant, Aman, Kanika) and Sarla Chahal have submitted a joint disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) to NSE on 11 June 2026. This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer or group of persons acting in concert crosses 5% shareholding. The precise shareholding acquired, consideration, and timing are stated in the original NSE filing document dated 11 June 2026.
